b3dt.summary: CAD: goals (ordered features: bosses, holes, pockets, revolves, patterns, fillets, lofts, sweeps, threads, text) -> build123d solids, STEP files, scripts
b3dt.cost: light (milliseconds to ~1 s per part): run it next to the Claude app

optional_extras.render: 3D images with VTK (quality high: lit, smooth); needs EGL, OSMesa or xvfb

feat.summary: FEA: static, modal, buckling, steady heat (with thermal stress), DC conduction, electrostatics, Joule heating (Gmsh + CalculiX)
feat.cost: light to moderate (seconds to minutes per study)

optional_extras.render: 3D images with VTK (quality high: lit, smooth); needs EGL, OSMesa or xvfb

backends.name: CalculiX (ccx)
backends.without: the reference solver runs static, modal and thermal on small meshes; no buckling

backends.name: Gmsh
backends.without: only box parts can be meshed

env.FEAT_CCX: path to the CalculiX executable (default: ccx on PATH, /opt/homebrew/bin, ...)
env.FEAT_EXECUTOR: local | slurm: long studies as SLURM jobs (docs/EXECUTION.md)
env.FEAT_SLURM_MIN_MINUTES: studies estimated shorter than this run locally
env.FEAT_SLURM_ARGS: extra sbatch arguments, e.g. --nice=100 (a --mem here replaces FEAT_SLURM_MEM)
env.FEAT_SLURM_NODE: local | any | node list: a cluster of several nodes keeps jobs on this node (local, default) unless the home folder is shared (any)
env.FEAT_EXIT_WHEN_STALE: a server whose release is no longer current exits when idle: 1 always, 0 never (default: shared installs)
env.FEAT_SLURM_MEM: job memory: auto (default: from the estimated mesh size and solver, else 8G) | a size, e.g. 16G | none (SLURM's default)
env.FEAT_MAX_TIMEOUT: ceiling for a study's run.timeout_s (seconds; unset: none)
env.FEAT_MAX_MEM: ceiling for a study's run.mem (e.g. 32G; unset: none)
env.FEAT_MAX_PROCS: ceiling for a study's run.procs / procs (unset: none)

cfdt.summary: CFD: steady flow, laminar or k-omega SST, internal or external; incompressible, or with energy: compressible air to transonic, heated walls, buoyancy (OpenFOAM)
cfdt.cost: heavy (minutes to hours per study): a good candidate for a remote workstation

optional_extras.render: 3D images with VTK (quality high, isosurfaces); needs EGL, OSMesa or xvfb

uses.feat: external-flow loads into FEA, chain benchmarks

tuning.why: 3 h per study: OpenFOAM runs on a workstation are long

backends.name: OpenFOAM
backends.without: meshing, case writing and the 2D reference solver only

backends.name: Gmsh
backends.without: only box domains can be meshed

env.CFDT_FOAM: OpenFOAM's etc/bashrc (or PATH if the shell already has OpenFOAM)
env.CFDT_EXECUTOR: local | slurm: long studies as SLURM jobs (docs/EXECUTION.md)
env.CFDT_SLURM_MIN_MINUTES: studies estimated shorter than this run locally
env.CFDT_SLURM_NODE: local | any | node list: a cluster of several nodes keeps jobs on this node (local, default) unless the home folder is shared (any)
env.CFDT_SLURM_MEM: job memory: auto (from the cell estimate) | a size | none; a --mem in CFDT_SLURM_ARGS wins
env.CFDT_EXIT_WHEN_STALE: a server whose release is no longer current exits when idle: 1 always, 0 never (default: shared installs)
env.CFDT_MPIRUN: MPI launcher (default mpirun; inside a SLURM job it uses the allocation)
env.CFDT_CELLS_PER_RANK: at most cells/N MPI ranks, so small cases run serially (default 5000)
env.CFDT_MAX_TIMEOUT: ceiling for a study's run.timeout_s (seconds; unset: none)
env.CFDT_MAX_MEM: ceiling for a study's run.mem (e.g. 32G; unset: none)
env.CFDT_MAX_PROCS: ceiling for a study's run.procs / solve.procs (unset: none; with SLURM also a node's cores)

lmpt.summary: Atomistic: crystals and molecular liquids; MD, elastic constants, EOS, vacancies, surfaces, thermal expansion (LAMMPS)
lmpt.cost: moderate to heavy (seconds to hours per study): local or remote

optional_extras.lammps: LAMMPS from PyPI (wheel) instead of a system LAMMPS; needs MPI libraries, see BACKENDS.md

backends.name: LAMMPS
backends.without: nothing runs (inputs can still be written)

env.LMPT_EXECUTOR: local | slurm: long studies as SLURM jobs (docs/EXECUTION.md)
env.LMPT_SLURM_MIN_MINUTES: studies estimated shorter than this run locally
env.LMPT_SLURM_ARGS: extra sbatch arguments, e.g. --nice=100 (a --mem here replaces LMPT_SLURM_MEM)
env.LMPT_SLURM_NODE: SLURM node for jobs: local (default: this node, when the cluster has several) | any | a node list
env.LMPT_EXIT_WHEN_STALE: a server whose release is no longer current exits when idle: 1 always, 0 never (default: shared installs)
env.LMPT_STALE_CHECK_S: how often an idle server checks whether it is stale, seconds (default 20)
env.LMPT_SLURM_MEM: job memory: auto (default: from ranks and atoms) | a size, e.g. 8G | none (SLURM's default)
env.LMPT_SLURM_TIME: job time limit: timeout (default: LMPT_TIMEOUT + 10 min) | estimate (from the study's estimate, for backfill)
env.LMPT_SLURM_TIME_FACTOR: with LMPT_SLURM_TIME=estimate: limit = factor x estimate + 10 min (default 3)
env.LMPT_ATOMS_PER_RANK: at most atoms/N MPI ranks, so small cells run on fewer ranks (default 2000)
env.LMPT_MAX_TIMEOUT: ceiling for a study's run.timeout_s (seconds; unset: none)
env.LMPT_MAX_MEM: ceiling for a study's run.mem (e.g. 32G; unset: none)
env.LMPT_MAX_PROCS: ceiling for a study's run.procs / procs (unset: none)

omct.summary: System dynamics: circuits, mechanics, DC motors, heat paths, controllers on MSL 4.0.0; transient, steady, linearisation (modes, Bode), sweeps on one build (OpenModelica)
omct.cost: light (seconds per study; sweeps minutes): runs where OpenModelica is installed

uses.feat: stiffness, mass, modal frequency, conductance as lumped values; chain benchmark
uses.b3dt: masses from goals' volumes; chain benchmark

backends.name: OpenModelica (omc)
backends.without: the reference solver runs linear networks (no build, no OpenModelica checks)

env.OMCT_OMC: the omc executable (default: omc on the PATH)
env.OMCT_MSL_VERSION: Modelica Standard Library version to load (default 4.0.0)
env.OMCT_SOLVER: auto | omc | ref (auto: omc when found; ref: the reference solver, linear networks only)
env.OMCT_PROCS: sweep points at once per study (default 1; a study's run.procs overrides it)
env.OMCT_COMPILE_PROCS: parallel C compile of a build, omc -n (default 4)
env.OMCT_OMP_THREADS: threads inside one simulation (default 1: more only slow it down, measured on mochi)
env.OMCT_EXECUTOR: local | slurm: long studies (big sweeps) as SLURM jobs (docs/EXECUTION.md)
env.OMCT_SLURM_MIN_MINUTES: studies estimated shorter than this run locally (default 1)
env.OMCT_SLURM_ARGS: extra sbatch arguments, e.g. --nice=100 (a --mem here replaces OMCT_SLURM_MEM)
env.OMCT_SLURM_NODE: local | any | node list: a cluster of several nodes keeps jobs on this node (local, default) unless the home folder is shared (any)
env.OMCT_EXIT_WHEN_STALE: a server whose release is no longer current exits when idle: 1 always, 0 never (default: shared installs)
env.OMCT_SLURM_MEM: job memory: auto (default: 1 GB + 256 MB per CPU) | a size, e.g. 4G | none (SLURM's default)
env.OMCT_SLURM_TIME: job time limit: timeout (default: OMCT_TIMEOUT + 10 min) | estimate (from the study's estimate, for backfill)
env.OMCT_SLURM_TIME_FACTOR: with OMCT_SLURM_TIME=estimate: limit = factor x estimate + 10 min (default 3)
env.OMCT_MAX_TIMEOUT: ceiling for a study's run.timeout_s (seconds; unset: none)
env.OMCT_MAX_MEM: ceiling for a study's run.mem (e.g. 16G; unset: none)
env.OMCT_MAX_PROCS: ceiling for a study's run.procs (unset: none)
